# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure" "example_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  application = "aws"
  name = "x"
  import_path = "x"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `application` (String) Platform this structure models. Immutable after creation.
Available values: "aws", "cloudflare".
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account

### Optional

- `import_path` (String) Optional unique Rego mount path in the form tenant.<application>.<name>; application must match. Omit to leave unmounted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure.example '<account_id>/<structure_id>'
```
